description: Get reviews for a specific human. Use this to check a human's reputation before hiring. Each review has `source` (who wrote it: `buyer` is the client; `withdrawal` is RentAHuman's automatic note for a spot the worker left after starting, refunded and not a quality rating; `managed`, `qa_engine` and `ai_backfill` are written by RentAHuman) and `job` (bounty title, paid or refunded, dispute outcome). Supports cursor-based pagination.

humanId.description: The human's ID to get reviews for
